description: This file defines a utility module for aggregating agent usage and cost data from multiple MongoDB collections (`session_tracking` and `llm-costs`). It includes functions for parsing currency strings and token counts, constructs MongoDB aggregation pipelines to compute costs and usage per agent, merges the results, and returns summarized statistics with filtering options.

methods.name: toNumberSafe(value)
methods.description: Converts a string or number representing currency or usage into a safe numerical value, handling common formats with dollar signs and commas.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost( db, { tenant_id, project_id, from, to, limit = 50, offset = 0, } = {} )
methods.description: Main exported function that aggregates agent usage and cost across relevant MongoDB collections, applying optional filters and returning a summary with per-agent statistics.
